{{Quote|From ''[Yaga Minor]'' we go to Lonnaw in Droma sector. After that, we'll cut through the edge of Glythe sector to Argai in Haldeen sector.|Captain Pakmillu|<ref name="Outbound" />}}
'''Argai Minor''', also known as '''Argai''', was a [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Haldeen sector/Legends|Haldeen sector]]. When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|exploration]] and [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' was launchd in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], Argai Minor was one of the stops on its shakedown cruise through Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]].

==Description==
Argai Minor,<ref name="TEA ArgaiMinor" /> also known simply as Argai,<ref name="Outbound" /> was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Haldeen">{{CSWECite|II|8|Haldeen sector}}</ref> located in the [[Argai Minor system/Legends|Argai Minor system]],<ref name="TEA ArgaiMinor" /> a part of the [[Haldeen sector/Legends|Haldeen sector]]<ref name="Outbound" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA ArgaiMinor" /> It shared its name with the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> planet [[Argai]].<ref name="Xim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|That's a lot of stops."''<br />''"Most will just be flybys. We won't actually stop unless there are problems.|Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi and Captain Pakmillu|<ref name="Outbound" />}}
[[File:FateOutboundFlight-TEA.png|thumb|right|300px|Argai Minor was a scheduled stop on the ''Outbound Flight''{{'s}} shakedown cruise.]]
In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], which depicts the launch of the [[Outbound Flight Project]], to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> the ''[[Outbound Flight]]'', a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] on a [[Outbound Flight Project|mission]] to [[Scout/Legends|explore]] and [[Colonist/Legends|colonize]] the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], was set to launch from the<ref name="Outbound" /> Outer Rim<ref name="TEA" /> planet [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]]. As part of a three-[[Standard week/Legends|week]]-long shakedown cruise<ref name="Outbound" /> along a route [[Star map/Legends|mapped]] through the home [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] of several of the project's principal supporters in the Republic's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]],<ref name="TEA" /> the starship was scheduled to stop at Argai Minor, a fact that the vessel's [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Pakmillu]], pointed out to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] when the latter visited the ship before launch.<ref name="Outbound" />

Shortly after the ''Outbound Flight'' left Yaga Minor's [[Yaga Minor system/Legends|star system]], [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]], [[Aide/Legends|assistant]] to the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], contacted [[Gender/Legends|his]] secret master, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Sidious. Doriana relayed to Sidious the fact that Kenobi and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] student, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], had unexpectedly joined the ''Outbound Flight''{{'s}} mission. In turn, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], who did not wish for Skywalker to be [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the planned attack on the vessel, ordered Doriana to arrange for the Padawan to leave the ''Outbound Flight''.<ref name="Outbound" />

Sidious's servant immediately began to plan his further actions accordingly, eventually ruling out the possibility of intercepting the starship at its next scheduled stop, in the [[Lonnaw system/Legends|Lonnaw system]], and realizing he would have to instead to make the attempt at Argai Minor. Doriana's deliberations were interrupted by Sidious, who ordered Doriana to carry on with his original instructions since the Sith Lord had decided he would himself arrange for Skywalker's departure from the ''Outbound Flight''. Ultimately, the starship visited Argai Minor before eventually leaving Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="Outbound" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Haldeen sector planet Argai was first mentioned in the [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Outbound" /> [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' equated it to<ref name="CSWE Argai">{{CSWECite|I|40|Argai}}</ref> the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] planet Argai, which had originally been introduced in ''[[Mission to Lianna]]'', a [[1992]] [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure authored by [[Joanne E. Wyrick]].<ref name="Lianna">''[[Mission to Lianna]]''</ref>

However, the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' introduced an "Argai Minor" [[Star system/Legends|star system]], placing it in grid square M-9 and therefore near the [[Haldeen system/Legends|Haldeen system]] and far from the Tion Cluster's [[Argai system/Legends|Argai system]].<ref name="TEA ArgaiMinor" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to that book later also placed both the Argai Minor and Haldeen systems in the Haldeen sector, therefore confirming that the world from ''Outbound Flight'' had been [[Retroactive continuity|retroactively]] established as Argai Minor.<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
